visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman is seen lying in bed under a red and white plaid blanket, holding a pink plush toy with a pig face. The bedroom has soft pinkish lighting and neutral-colored curtains in the background. (2) The woman sits up in bed, wearing light blue pajama pants and a pink short-sleeved shirt, adjusting the plush toy. (3) She walks to a large window with white frames and pulls back white sheer curtains, allowing bright natural daylight to flood into the room. (4) In a kitchen setting with pink cabinetry and white countertops, she places a blue tablet and a pair of dark-framed glasses on a light-colored wooden counter. (5) A medium shot shows her leaning against the counter while brushing her teeth. (6) Water is dispensed from a modern stainless steel tap into a pink ceramic mug sitting on the edge of a metal sink. (7) She is shown drinking from the pink mug while standing in the kitchen area. (8) On a wooden serving board, she pours green olive oil from a clear glass bottle into a small blue-and-white patterned ceramic bowl. (9) She uses metal scissors to snip open a small white sachet and pours a clear liquid into the bowl with the oil. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 日常生活. [Variety]: 最天早上最重要的一件事!. [Logo]: @Rosalinakitchen. [Subtitle]: 大家一早起來都會先做什麼事呢？. (2) [Variety]: 賴一下床，終於起來了. [Subtitle]: 我通常還是會賴一下床. (3) [Variety]: 奇怪？我的兔兔怎麼沒穿褲子？. [Subtitle]: 如果是假日，我就會賴久一點...哈. (4) [Variety]: 趕快穿好褲子就定位... OK!起床. [Subtitle]: OK!起床. (5) [Subtitle]: 我最喜歡早上起來，拉開窗簾的那一刻. (6) [Subtitle]: 讓陽光整個照射進來的感覺. (7) [Subtitle]: 一早我喜歡聽一下BBC或者音樂. (8) [Subtitle]: 靜靜的刷牙，梳洗. (9) [Subtitle]: 一早起來喝溫開水是很重要的！. (10) [Slogan]: 生飲橄欖油可以潤腸、補充橄欖多酚 Omega-9. [Subtitle]: 再來就是我每天最期待的事. (11) [Subtitle]: 趁空腹喝一點橄欖油 (10cc). (12) [Slogan]: 生紫蘇油補充 (Omega-3). [Subtitle]: 我喜歡再放一點生紫蘇油，味道會很順口. (13) [Slogan]: 巴薩米克醋 (促進胃酸分泌). [Subtitle]: 有人會加蜂蜜，但我覺得太甜了. (14) [Variety]: (提醒！胃潰瘍不能喝醋). [Subtitle]: 放一點巴薩米克醋，比例大約3:1. (15) [Subtitle]: 像這樣攪拌攪拌，混合乳化就可以了. (16) [Subtitle]: 然後用湯匙小口小口的喝. (17) [Subtitle]: 接著再喝300cc的溫水，讓腸道順暢. (18) [Subtitle]: 如果覺得空腹喝醋會不舒服. (19) [Subtitle]: 你可以配一點原味海苔或者麵包. (20) [Subtitle]: 起來身體律動一下. (21) [Variety]: 接下來就不用報告了吧？. [Subtitle]: 差不多就可以去上廁所了. (22) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.
